description: This file defines the Favorites class for SuiteCRM, extending Basic, with methods for managing user favorites, including retrieving, deleting, and saving favorites, as well as handling related data and permissions.

classes.name: Favorites
classes.description: Represents user favorites in SuiteCRM, providing methods to manage favorites including retrieval, deletion, and permission handling.

methods.name: deleteFavorite
methods.description: Marks a favorite record as deleted by setting its 'deleted' flag to 1.

methods.name: getFavoriteID
methods.description: Retrieves the favorite ID for a given module and record ID for the current user.

methods.name: getCurrentUserSidebarFavorites
methods.description: Fetches the current user's sidebar favorites, optionally filtered by a specific ID.

methods.name: getCurrentUserFavoritesForModule
methods.description: Returns the list of current user's favorites for a specified module, formatted for API response.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the Favorites object, assigning the current user if not already set.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Indicates whether the class implements a specific interface; always returns false for 'ACL'.
